title.en: Map of the MacGuard ecosystem and the state of each part
title.es: Mapa del ecosistema MacGuard y el estado de cada parte

alt.en: Seven parts in three groups. Trusted supply: YARA Channel (published). On the Mac: Installer Auditor (development), MacUSBGuard (validation), MacFirewallGuard (development) and MacProcessGuard (concept). Shared building blocks: MacCoreGuard (prototype) and MacGuardDesignKit (development). Solid arrow: YARA Channel supplies signed rules to Installer Auditor. Dashed arrows are planned or only tested with a mock: MacProcessGuard would give MacFirewallGuard process identity, and MacFirewallGuard has a client for MacCoreGuard tested only with a mock.
alt.es: Siete piezas en tres grupos. Suministro de confianza: YARA Channel (publicado). En el Mac: Installer Auditor (desarrollo), MacUSBGuard (validación), MacFirewallGuard (desarrollo) y MacProcessGuard (concepto). Bloques compartidos: MacCoreGuard (prototipo) y MacGuardDesignKit (desarrollo). Flecha continua: YARA Channel suministra reglas firmadas a Installer Auditor. Las flechas discontinuas son planificadas o solo probadas con un simulacro: MacProcessGuard daría a MacFirewallGuard la identidad del proceso, y MacFirewallGuard tiene un cliente de MacCoreGuard probado solo con un simulacro.
